text:
Rae: Heads-up from the docs triage queue: the function/tool-calling guide has a mix of old and new snippets. We should: standardize to v1 API names, add examples for JS/Python/Ruby, and include a single canonical strict JSON schema.
Diego: Agreed. I can update the JS and add a tiny TypeScript mapping note.
Nora: I'll do the schema and a short migration blurb. Prefer showing the strict schema as the canonical example and a one-liner about a lenient fallback.
Jamie: I can add Ruby since a user asked for it in the support ticket. Also flagging two broken anchors in the guide TOC.
Rae: Great. Migration blurb suggestion (one-liner at top): "If youare migrating from v0.x: rename `response_schema` -> `outputSchema` and `callTool()` -> `invokeTool()`." Keep it terse.
Diego: Proposed canonical JS snippet (v1):
```js
// v1 invokeTool example
const resp = await client.invokeTool('entity_extractor', {
  input: articleText,
  params: { temperature: 0 }
});
console.log(resp.output);
```
Diego: TypeScript note to map schema -> interface: a tiny example so folks see the benefit of strict schemas.
Nora: Canonical strict JSON schema to paste (copy-pasteable):
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "entities": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "object", "properties": {"text": {"type":"string"}, "type": {"type":"string"}}, "required": ["text"] } },
    "source": { "type": "string" }
  },
  "required": ["entities"],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```
Nora: Lenient note (one line): "If you need backward compatibility, set `additionalProperties: true` or accept an optional `metadata` field when parsing."
Jamie: Ruby snippet (v1 client):
```rb
# v1: invoke_tool
resp = client.invoke_tool('entity_extractor', input: article_text, params: { temperature: 0 })
puts resp.output
```
Rae: Nice. Also add tiny parse+validate examples in all three languages so readers don't blindly trust model output. Example JS validation flow:
```js
try {
  const parsed = JSON.parse(resp.output);
  validate(parsed, schema); // throws or returns false
} catch (err) {
  // fallback: return safe default or call model again with explicit system prompt
}
```
Nora: Python validation example:
```py
try:
  parsed = json.loads(resp.output)
  validate(parsed, schema)
except Exception:
  # log + fallback or re-call with clearer instructions
```
Jamie: Ruby validation example:
```rb
begin
  parsed = JSON.parse(resp.output)
  validate(parsed, schema)
rescue => e
  # fallback or re-call with stricter prompt
end
```
Diego: Add a short paragraph about guardrails: recommend `type: object` + `additionalProperties: false` for structured outputs and show how to handle parse failures gracefully.
Rae: Also add a one-line warning about prefix KV caching: deterministic tool outputs can be stale in long-lived sessions. Link to caching guide.
Jamie: Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/caching#prefix-kv I'll update the TOC anchors and remove the old /integrations/* links that 404.
Nora: Can we add a tiny test fixture under docs-fixtures/ showing an invalid output case to exercise schema-lint? I'll add one and reference it.
Diego: I'll include the TypeScript interface example and a note about how `additionalProperties: false` makes mapping to typed languages predictable.
Rae: CI plan: run docs/link-check and docs/schema-lint on the branch. Also ensure preview builds (remove fenced codeblock titles to avoid md renderer edge cases).
Docs Bot: Jobs queued: docs/link-check (high), docs/schema-lint. Branch: docs/structured-tooling-v1.
PreviewBot: Preview build queued. Preview available at https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-690/ (48h)
Jamie: FYI markdown lint caught a trailing space in one of the examples; pushed fix.
Nora: schema-lint flagged a missing required field in the fixture; pushed updated fixture.
Diego: snippets lint clean. I pushed a small rename to keep variable names consistent.
Rae: Quick review checklist before merge: 1) canonical snippets for JS/Python/Ruby use invokeTool/invoke_tool 2) canonical schema is strict and copy-paste ready 3) migration blurb present 4) parse+validate examples added 5) caching note + link present 6) TOC anchors fixed 7) preview passes.
Jamie: I'm going to run an accessibility link check on the preview as well.
Nora: tests green locally.
Diego: preview passed and looks good.
Rae: Approved. Merge when CI is green.
Docs Bot: PR merged. Changelog: small bullet added under "Docs" noting v1 snippets + migration tip.
Rae: Thanks team. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
